item.text: [{"task_id":"67c52801","source_lines":["def run(params, grid, demos):","    bg = int(round(params['rule'][0]))","    base_offset = int(round(params['rule'][1]))","    slot_offset = int(round(params['rule'][2]))","    depth = int(round(params['rule'][3]))","    rotation = int(round(params['rule'][4]))","    unit = int(round(params['rule'][5]))","    h, w = grid.shape","    if depth <= 0 or depth > h or unit <= 0 or unit > w:","        return grid.copy()","    if base_offset < -h or base_offset >= h or slot_offset < -h or slot_offset >= h:","        return grid.copy()","    base_row = base_offset % h","    slot_row = slot_offset % h","    ground = int(grid[base_row, 0])","    objects = []","    for color in np.unique(grid[:slot_row]):","        color = int(color)","        if color == bg or color == ground:","            continue","        points = np.argwhere(grid[:slot_row] == color)","        lo = np.min(points, axis=0)","        hi = np.max(points, axis=0)","        patch = grid[int(lo[0]):int(hi[0]) + unit, int(lo[1]):int(hi[1]) + unit].copy()","        patch = np.where(patch == color, color, bg)","        if patch.shape[0] != depth:","            patch = np.rot90(patch, rotation)","        objects.append(patch)","    gaps = []","    start = None","    for col in range(w):","        if grid[slot_row, col] == bg:","            if start is None:","                start = col","        elif start is not None:","            gaps.append((start, col))","            start = None","    if start is not None:","        gaps.append((start, w))","    out = grid.copy()","    out[np.logical_and(grid != bg, grid != ground)] = bg","    for left, right in gaps:","        chosen = None","        for index in range(len(objects)):","            patch = objects[index]","            if patch.shape[0] == depth and patch.shape[1] == right - left:","                chosen = index","                break","        if chosen is None:","            return grid.copy()","        patch = objects.pop(chosen)","        top = slot_row - depth + unit","        if top < 0:","            return grid.copy()","        out[top:slot_row + unit, left:right] = patch","    if len(objects) != 0:","        return grid.copy()","    return out"],"shapes":{"rule":[6]},"params":{"rule":[0,-1,-2,2,1,1]},"rationale":"Rotate each floating rectangle when necessary to make it two cells tall, then fit it into the equally wide gap in the ground's upper row.
